NATIONAL LIBRARY WEEK CELEBRATIONS 2024
Overview
, Warangal, proudly celebrated National Library Week with a series of engaging events aimed at promoting the importance of libraries in academic and research excellence. The celebrations, held at the university’s central library, brought together students, faculty, and library professionals to emphasize the role of libraries in shaping knowledge and innovation.
The event featured book exhibitions, expert talks on digital resources, and interactive sessions highlighting the university’s extensive library facilities. Special workshops on research methodologies and citation management provided students with valuable academic skills. Additionally, a reading competition and quiz on literature and general knowledge encouraged active participation.
library, known for its rich collection of books, journals, and digital archives, continues to be a hub of learning and intellectual growth. The National Library Week celebrations reinforced the university’s commitment to fostering a strong reading culture and providing state-of-the-art resources for students and scholars.
